body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Odd gentle forest thinker; notices connections and support, curious rather than cryptic or falsely wise. Voice direction: Low female register speaking English with a light Polish accent. Rich muted woody resonance, slow attentive observations and warm curiosity. Grounded and clear rather than breathy or mysterious. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: Something came loose there. That piece was holding another one safely in place. When it moved away, the connection disappeared.
